subject: design/local-execution-logs
statement: Codegate invocation logs and pruning use .pyxis/logs/codegate, contract-gate's default report scratch uses .pyxis/logs/contract-gate, e2e-design and e2e-review retain structured diagnostics under .pyxis/logs/reviews while continuing stderr output, and the Lavish driver writes server output under .pyxis/logs/doc-review. Explicit shared report exports and codegate verdict, cache, and worktree state retain their existing artifact or state locations.
intent: Consolidate gate and review execution output while preserving the shared reports and durable state that other users need to review or resume work.
rationale: Review findings, contract evidence, and verdict state have different ownership from server and command diagnostics. Only the diagnostic and default scratch sinks belong in the ignored log tree; moving shared results would break the approved cross-user Git workflow.
fit_criterion: Codegate invocation and pruning tests use the new log root. Review logger tests cover JSON persistence and stderr fallback. The Lavish driver suite verifies server-log placement and completes the open/listen/reply/end lifecycle.

provenance.note: Records the boundary between gate/review diagnostics and shared evidence.
